rationale: Rear-end motor vehicle collision causing damage to the policyholder's vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder—clearly within auto coverage.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at a red light yesterday at 8:15 AM by a vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled with extensive trunk and rear-end damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information included.

case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
